messages:
owen: Planning to flip the BurstGate tweak for aurora-pool autoscaler tonight at 21:30 UTC. Non-urgent change: reduce min replicas by 1 and enable short burst headroom. I'll run the change and watch telemetry. Rolling window 21:30-22:00. Smoke window 5m after change. Rollback plan ready; tagging owners.

priya: I can own smoke tests — latency + eviction checks. Will run the smoke script and paste results here.

jen: Can someone drop the PR? I can do a quick config/ops review.

owen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orch/pull/4728 — tiny autoscaler.yaml change. @kevin can you do config validation (yaml schema + threshold sanity)?

kevin: skimmed the PR, looks fine. One small nit on eviction threshold comment but safe for canary. Ran the validation script locally, no schema errors.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by owen at 3320012720. CI: build#4823 ✓, e2e ✓, infra-checks ✓.

sarah: quick reminder — set manual drain on canary nodes pre-change so long-running inferences aren't preempted.

priya: smoke run command I'm using: ```./scripts/smoke_gpu_pool.sh --pool aurora --duration 300 --trace p95``` will post a short excerpt.

owen: starting deploy now (21:31 UTC). Doing a rolling apply to avoid disrupting existing pods. Monitoring dashboard + logs. Rollback command if needed: `kubectl apply -f autoscaler-prev.yaml` and then trigger scale-up job.

priya: smoke results (first 2m): 200 synthetic requests, p50 21ms, p95 78ms, error rate 0.3% (3/1000, unrelated 502 from test harness). No eviction spikes observed. Small log excerpt: ```eviction_rate: 0.0
kvcache_hits: 92%
queue_depth: 0-2``` :thumbsup:

jen: LGTM from me based on the smoke. Left an approve on the PR.

kevin: watching infra metrics — GPU util and mem stable. I added a transient alert for p95 > 300ms for the window.

owen: holding for observation until 21:40 UTC. If no regressions, we'll schedule similar change for beta pools tomorrow morning.

priya: note for rollback trigger: immediate rollback if error rate +5% absolute or sustained p95 > 200ms for 3 consecutive minutes. I'll be oncall 21:30-22:00 and will roll back if thresholds hit.

sarah: thanks — I enabled manual drain on the two canary nodes and updated the runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/gpu-burstgate-smoke.

owen: all good here, closing the loop — change is live, metrics look healthy at 21:39 UTC. Will file a short postcheck in the deploy doc and schedule follow-up for tomorrow. Thanks everyone for quick reviews and help. :tada:
